A Bachelor's degree, and, in addition, 20 credits in the main field of study Electrical Engineering at Master's level, including Thematic Studies in All-Electrical Propulsion Systems. Participation in Electric Propulsion Systems or All-Electric Powertrains. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

140 credits in science/engineering, out of which 20 credits in electrical engineering at Master's level. Electric Propulsion Systems and Batteries and Storage. Participation in Power Electronics II and Design of Electric Motors. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

140 credits in science/engineering, out of which 20 credits in electrical engineering at Master's level. Electric Propulsion Systems, and Batteries and Storage. Participation in Power Electronics II and Design of Electric Motors. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

A Bachelor's degree, equivalent to a Swedish Kandidatexamen. In addition, 30 credits at Master's level in the main field of all-electric propulsion systems including Thematic Studies in All-Electric Propulsion Systems. Participation in 15 credits of applied courses at Master's level. The applied courses in the programme are Electric Cars, Electric Operation of Heavy Vehicles: Trucks, Buses and Work Machines, Electric Operation of Aircraft, Drones and Helicopters, Rail-Bound Electric Traffic: Trains and Trams, Electric Operation for Ships and Boats. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering, including 15 credits in Electrical Engineering. Participation in Design of Electric Motors. Participation in Electric Vehicles on Land, Water and in the Air, or can be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering, of which 15 credits in Electrical Engineering. Participation in one of the courses Electric Propulsion Systems or All-Electric Powertrains. Participation in Design of Electric Motors, or taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Alternative 1: 120 credits in science and technology, including 5 credits power engineering, 5 credits automatic control, and 5 credits scientific computing. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Alternative 2: 130 credits in science and technology, including 10 credits in Energy Technology at Master's level. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Alternative 3: 120 credits in science and technology, including 15 credits in power engineering. Ability to use computer-based calculation tools, such as MATLAB Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
120 credits in science/engineering. Participation in Rechargeable batteries or Batteries and storage. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
60 credits in science/engineering including electric circuit theory. 30 credits in mathematics including linear algebra and multivariable calculus.

120 credits in science/engineering including 10 credits in electrical engineering. A project plan approved by the department is required for admission. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering including 10 credits in electrical engineering. A project plan approved by the department is required for admission. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
130 credits in science/engineering including Power Engineering and Power Electronics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

150 credits in science/engineering including 30 credits at Master's level within the specialisation Embedded Systems in the Master Programme in Engineering Physics; or alternatively 30 credits at Master's level within the specialisations Electrical System Control or Renewable Electrical Generation in the Master Programme in Electrical Engineering, and Embedded Systems in the Master Programme in Information Technology, or 30 credits at Master's level in Electrical Engineering within the Master Programme in All-Electric Propulsion Systems. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering, including basic knowledge in electric circuit theory and electronics. Participation in Transform Methods (spec. Fourier series), or the course can be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering. Participation in 10 credits at Master's level in science/engineering. Participation in one of the courses Power Electronics I and Power Electronics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Option 1: 120 credits, including 90 credits in science/engineering. Participation in the course Industrial Project Management I. Option 2: 120 credits, including 90 credits in science/engineering. Industrial Engineering and Management I: The Functions of the Corporation, Industrial Management III: Project in Business and Technology Development. Participation in Strategic Management in Technology-Intensive Firms. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
